description: A web platform that aggregates coupons and deals from multiple merchants, organized by categories, allowing users to discover, save, and use discounts while providing merchants a simple interface to publish offers.
target_users: Small and medium merchants wanting to promote deals
Affiliate marketers looking for deal sources
core_features: Unified list of deals from many merchants
Search and filter deals by category, location, and discount amount
Display coupon codes with copy‑to‑clipboard functionality
User accounts with saved favorite deals
Admin dashboard for CRUD of merchants, deals, and categories
future_features: Personalized deal recommendations based on user behavior
Mobile app push notifications for time‑limited offers
pages: Deal Detail – view coupon and copy code
Category View – filter deals by category
Merchant Profile – list deals from a merchant
Admin Dashboard – manage merchants, deals, categories

milestones: Set up FastAPI backend with SQLite
Implement Merchant, Deal, Category models and CRUD APIs
Create React UI for Home, Deal Detail, Category, and Merchant pages
Add user registration and saved favorites feature
Introduce coupon code copy functionality and deal expiration handling
Deploy initial marketing site and SEO optimization
Build recommendation engine for personalized deals
Launch email newsletter and push notification service
Prepare mobile‑responsive design and PWA support
Add analytics and reporting for merchant performance
